Ravi (arch): Heads-up: ran into a failure mode when hosted->private routing uses control-plane tokens the private adapter doesn't accept. Need a clear handshake pattern so private deployments can validate identity without exposing raw CP creds.
Becca (eng-runtime): curious — is this during fallback or normal routing?
Ravi (arch): during fallback. Hosted tried to route model traffic to customer VPC adapter; adapter returned 403 saying token audience mismatch. Private customers often lock allowed issuers.
Diego (eng-platform): we've seen this; some private adapters only accept locally minted service tokens. We need a contract: a short-lived "proof" signed by the control-plane that the adapter can verify with a stored cert.
Priya (sec): needs to be audit-friendly and revocable. Also must not let control-plane impersonate tenant capabilities beyond routing.
Elena (product): timeline sensitivity: customers expect minimal onboarding friction. Any contract that requires cert exchange is ok during onboarding but should be automated.
Ravi (arch): proposal sketch: capability discovery + signed proof flow. Two new endpoints on adapters: 
1) GET /v1/capabilities -> returns JSON list of supported auth modes and a public cert thumbprint.
2) POST /v1/verify-proof -> accepts a signed proof issued by control-plane/authority and returns 200 if adapter accepts the proof.
Becca (eng-runtime): sample "proof" payload idea (JWT-like, compact for perf):
```
{
  "iss": "controlplane.redwood",
  "sub": "tenant:acme-corp",
  "aud": "adapter://acme-vpc-01",
  "exp": 1679100000,
  "rid": "req-5f3a",
  "caps": ["route:inference","model:pin:stable-v1"]
}
--signed-with-controlplane-key--
```
Priya (sec): constraints:
- TTL <= 30s for fast-paths, <= 5m only for pre-warm operations.
- caps must be minimal (routing + model-id), no raw tenant tokens.
- include nonce/rid to avoid replay.
Diego (eng-platform): onboarding: control-plane stores adapter cert, adapter exposes cert thumbprint in capabilities. During route-time: control-plane signs proof -> adapter verifies using stored cert.
Elena (product): how do we handle customer-managed KMS where private adapter won't accept control-plane signature at all?
Ravi (arch): for customer-managed KMS we have alternative: adapter provides a booth-within VPC URL to which CP can POST an exchange request; adapter responds with a short-lived local token after performing its own auth checks. This is like the exchange-handle model but initiated by adapter discovery.
Becca (eng-runtime): perf notes: verifying signatures per-request will add latency. Options:
- verify once per short TTL and cache a verification result keyed by (rid or nonce)
- use a fast HMAC-mode with pre-shared symmetric key for high-throughput internal adapters (hosted<->dedicated)
- fallback to full asym crypto for unknown adapters
Priya (sec): cache must be keyed by nonce/audit id and must not be long-lived. Also require an audit log entry per resolved proof: proof.accepted with origin, proof.caps, resolved_at.
Diego (eng-platform): metrics to add: proof_verification_latency, proof_verify_fail_rate, capability_discovery_failures. ops-bot: created metric requests ticket #OPS-412.
ops-bot: ticket created: OPS-412: add proof verification metrics and alerts.
Ravi (arch): edge-case: what if adapter rotates cert? discovery endpoint should include cert rotation window and a cert_chain or url for fetching current cert. We should fail-open only when adapter explicitly configured as "trial-mode"; otherwise fail-closed.
Becca (eng-runtime): implementation plan I propose:
- add capability discovery call in route initialization
- control-plane maintains signing key with short-lived signing tokens for route operations
- runtime sends signed proof during route setup and on fallback (if required)
- worker verifies proof or proxies to adapter /verify-proof if adapter prefers local exchange
Diego (eng-platform): also add a healthcheck field in capabilities so adapters can advertise "supports-async-verify" to allow a non-blocking warm path.
Priya (sec): doc checklist: threat-model, replay-protection, key-rotation guidance, onboarding steps for customers. Add mandatory test vectors.
Elena (product): docs + onboarding automation should be ready in 2 sprints for new private customers. Existing private customers can opt-in; we'll notify them.
Ravi (arch): follow-ups: I'll write an RFC with sequence diagrams: discovery -> proof -> verify -> audit. Also include a lightweight HMAC fallback for high-throughput hosted<->dedicated flows.
Becca (eng-runtime): timeline: spike next week to measure verify latency; we may add persistent verification cache with TTL per adapter.
Priya (sec): require audit hook: every proof accepted must produce an immutable event with proof_id and resolved_by fields.
Diego (eng-platform): noted. I'll add metrics and revocation endpoints: /v1/revoke-proof?id=... for emergency revokes.
Ravi (arch): closing: keep raw tenant credentials out of travel; proofs only, auditable, minimal caps, nonce-bound. Thanks. :white_check_mark:
ops-bot: milestone created: adapter-proof-handshake (owner: becca)
